samples.text:
The i.MX 93 uses the IOMUX Controller (IOMUXC) to route the pins for the UART peripheral. Specifically, the UART1_RXD and UART1_TXD pins can be mapped to different peripherals such as LPUART1, ELE, LPSPI2, TPM1, or GPIO1 based on the MUX_MODE setting in the IOMUXC.
